title: Expected distribution
view: Shared foot base (visuals/distribution_bases/foot): skeleton of the right foot from above, then the right foot from above, from below (sole) and from its outer side; right foot.
teachingPoint: A posterior tibial block at the ankle numbs the sole of the foot and the underside of the toes.
claims: Skin: the sole and the plantar surface of all the toes (medial and lateral plantar nerves, medial calcaneal branch to the heel); the lateral border strip stays grey (sural).
Not shaded: the dorsum of the foot. Sources: record anatomy; NYSORA posterior tibial distribution.
Right foot; one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app. No bone is shaded: this nerve is not a reliable supply to the foot bones (record anatomy).
